message.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    We show a strong form of the quantitative Sobolev inequality in
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>\mathbb{R}^n</jats:tex-math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    for
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>p\geq 2</jats:tex-math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    , where the deficit of a function
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>u\in \dot W^{1,p}</jats:tex-math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    controls
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>\| \nabla u -\nabla v\|_{L^p}</jats:tex-math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    for an extremal function
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:tex-math>v</jats:tex-math>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    in the Sobolev inequality.
                  </jats:p>
title: Gradient stability for the Sobolev inequality: the case $p\geq 2$
container-title: Journal of the European Mathematical Society
